keyEvents.text: Delay in match (Lens).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Niko Sigur (Toulouse) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Florian Thauvin (Lens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Lens 0, Toulouse 1. Jacen Russell-Rowe (Toulouse) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner.
Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Toulouse. Seny Koumbassa replaces Mark McKenzie.
Second Half begins Lens 0, Toulouse 1.
Goal! Lens 1, Toulouse 1. Michaël Cuisance (Lens) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the high centre of the goal.
Substitution, Lens. Amadou Haidara replaces Michaël Cuisance.
Substitution, Lens. Saud Abdulhamid replaces Ruben Aguilar.
Substitution, Lens. Abdallah Sima replaces Mezian Mesloub.
Amadou Haidara (Lens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Toulouse. Sion Oppong replaces Santiago Hidalgo.
Substitution, Lens. Ismaëlo Ganiou replaces Jhoanner Chávez.
Substitution, Toulouse. Aron Dønnum replaces Jacen Russell-Rowe.
Substitution, Lens. Michal Skóras replaces Florian Sotoca.
Substitution, Toulouse. Alexis Vossah replaces Thomas Jørgensen.
